finding: Capture.recheck checks observed leaf snapshots and capture-root metadata, but an extra file introduced inside an existing cas/ or meta/ directory after initial closure need not change root mtime or existing leaves. Complete input-closure promise is therefore not fully repeated at pre-stage/pre-link checks.
effect: Only previously captured authenticated bytes reach prospective output; this is an input-closure validation gap, not a source apply or execution capability.
proposedRepair: Re-run the same bounded exact closure during every late capture recheck, including before stage and before exclusive final link; preserve explicit expected locator set.
requiredNegative: Owned fixture adds an extra leaf inside an existing captured subdirectory after initial closure; late recheck must refuse before final packet link.
